name: Naoya
source:
Yuri's lover. The encounter began when Yuri called out to him while he was searching for a photo subject in the city. She called it "Nao". In order to support Yuri's dream, he told her that it wouldn't be a deeper relationship until it came true, but there was a serious secret hidden in it. 

Voiced by: Hyoyoshi Fujitomi
